name: adtl_hov
brief:
Higher-order vector traceless forward mode

Provides the adtl_hov::adouble class supporting traceless automatic
differentiation with higher-order Taylor coefficients in multiple
directions simultaneously. Configurable via setNumDir(), setDegree(),
and setMode().

**Modes:**
- ADTL_ZOS: Zero-order scalar (function value only)
- ADTL_FOV: First-order vector (Jacobian computation)
- ADTL_INDO: Index domain propagation (sparsity)
- ADTL_HOV: Higher-order vector (full Taylor coefficients)
